row.team_price_text: Pricing page blocked (Cloudflare); per employee per month admin fee
row.evidence: Justworks' help centre positions Justworks as the source of truth ("Manage employee info in Justworks as your single source of truth, and let our integrations sync info across these tools"); no SCIM, SAML or user API into Justworks is documented.
row.notes: HR/PEO source system, scored as a provisioning target (rule 3b): no SCIM endpoint, SAML/OIDC SSO or public user API into Justworks found. Sign-in is username and password with mandatory MFA. Employees are invited by admins; admins are created from Company-level Permissions. Outbound only: curated integrations (Culture Amp, 15Five, Leapsome, Carta, Brex, Ramp, Trainual, Vanta, Electric, allwhere) sync employee data out of Justworks. Pricing page (justworks.com/pricing) blocks all automated fetches, so plan prices are not recorded; help centre confirms PEO Basic and Plus plans plus a Payroll product, billed per employee per month. No Okta OIN page or Entra gallery tutorial found. Status none by absence (medium).

citations.title: Pricing
citations.quote: There are two types of pricing plans at Justworks: the Basic plan and the Plus plan.

citations.title: Pricing
citations.quote: You will be charged an administrative fee each month for each active employee, each employee who received a payment in that month, and each unpaid owner.

citations.title: Integrations at Justworks
citations.quote: Say goodbye to manual software provisioning. Manage employee info in Justworks as your single source of truth, and let our integrations sync info across these tools:

citations.title: Company Level Permissions
citations.quote: To make someone an admin, you have two options. You can navigate to Company-level Permissions and click the blue pencil next to "Your admins."

citations.title: Company Level Permissions
citations.quote: The first step to give someone a permission is to make them an admin on your account. Only admins can have company-level permissions.

citations.title: Electric AI Integration

citations.title: Electric AI Integration
